steps.text: Record R-02437 (row 2438 of the export) gives its amount as "1,250.00". `parseAmount` passed the text straight to `Number()`, which reads a thousands separator as not a number, so the record was skipped. It now drops a comma between digit groups before reading. All 5,000 records are booked and the tests pass.
